articles.title: Zelenskyy says Russia fired over 200 drones at Ukraine as truce expires
articles.summary: Russia and Ukraine resumed intense air attacks following the expiry of a US-brokered three-day truce. Ukrainian President Zelenskyy reported over 200 drones targeted Ukraine overnight, marking a significant escalation. This highlights the persistent aerial warfare tactics and the immense challenges in achieving lasting peace in the ongoing conflict, crucial for understanding global defence dynamics.

articles.title: Quality consciousness key to global competitiveness, says consumer affairs secretary
articles.summary: Consumer Affairs Secretary Nidhi Khare emphasized the critical need for Indian manufacturers to embed quality consciousness in their operations to compete effectively in global markets. This strategic focus aims to boost India's economic competitiveness and enhance the 'Brand India' image internationally. The push for quality aligns with national goals to strengthen manufacturing capabilities and secure a stronger foothold in the global economy, promoting exports and overall growth.

articles.title: Shoppers Are Ready for AI to Steer the Cart, Not Swipe the Card
articles.summary: New research highlights the dual nature of digital assistants. While convenient for tasks like grocery shopping, they present significant risks, including potential identity theft and unauthorized access to bank accounts. This underscores the growing cybersecurity challenges associated with advanced digital technologies. SSB aspirants should be mindful of these evolving threats and the critical importance of robust security measures in an increasingly digitalized society.

articles.title: Starving on the front lines: Food supply in crisis as Ukraine fights Russia
articles.summary: Photos of four emaciated Ukrainian soldiers, reportedly starving on the front line for up to 17 days due to lack of food deliveries, sparked significant outrage in Ukraine. This incident in late April brought critical issues regarding military logistics and troop welfare during the ongoing conflict into sharp focus, prompting calls for immediate improvements in frontline support.

articles.title: Russia, Ukraine resume strikes as truce expires, one dead: authorities
articles.summary: Russia has resumed its offensive against Ukraine following the expiration of a three-day truce. Ukrainian authorities reported drone attacks on the capital, Kyiv, and the death of one person in the eastern Dnipropetrovsk region. This escalation marks the continuation of the conflict, highlighting the ongoing geopolitical tensions and the human cost of the war between the two nations.

articles.title: Russia, Ukraine resume strikes as truce expires
articles.summary: Russia has resumed military strikes on Ukraine following the expiration of a three-day truce, according to Ukrainian authorities. The capital, Kyiv, faced drone attacks, and one fatality was reported in the eastern Dnipropetrovsk region. This development signifies a renewed escalation in the ongoing conflict, highlighting the volatile geopolitical situation and the continued humanitarian impact of the war.
